lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured lattice of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in parallel horizontal rows, extending from the posterior gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a series of grid-like nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges traversing the upper-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance shift from high-intensity upper edges to lower-intensity ventral shadows.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of discrete, high-luminance blobs within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the posterior and medial regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Densely clustered, small-diameter high-luminance spots covering the leading edge and entire visible surface of the primary pectoral fin.
